title: Canonical defining ideal products and quotients on an algebraic space
statement: Let $S$ be a scheme [def-pc-scheme], $X,Z$ algebraic spaces over $S$ with their small etale ringed sites [def-trf-algebraic-space], and $i:Z\to X$ a morphism. Use module sheaves [def-weil-sheaf-of-modules-category] and the chart projections defining direct image [def-trf-space-etale-module-functors]. For an etale scheme chart $V\to X$, define $I(V)$ as the intersection, over all charts $(T,a)$ of $Z\times_X V$, of the kernels of the regular-function maps $\Gamma(V,\mathcal O_V)\to\Gamma(T,\mathcal O_T)$. Thus $I=\ker(\mathcal O_X\to i_*\mathcal O_Z)$; for a closed immersion it is its defining ideal. For $F$ an $\mathcal O_X$-module and $N$ a subpresheaf of modules of $F$, define $IN$ to be the intersection of all sheaf submodules $K$ of $F$ containing $am$ on every chart $V$, for every $a\in I(V)$ and $m\in N(V)$. Define $I^0F$ to be the full submodule of $F$ and $I^{n+1}F=I(I^nF)$. Each resulting subpresheaf is a sheaf (intersections of subsheaves are subsheaves), and its sectionwise inclusion defines $I^nF\hookrightarrow F$. Define $F/I^nF$ as the canonical cokernel of this inclusion, transported from the small affine ringed model [def-sfb-space-small-ringed-model] by its specified restriction equivalence. No Noetherian, coherence, or reducedness assumption is needed for these constructions.
